notes: Credit, and zones from the spawn room and the door at the end of the green level aimed at `ende` (gb-maps-1, chk-maps run 117). The route runs lvl1st*, then stageblue into lvlbluest*, then lvlgreen into lvlgreenst*; those destinations are fall returns, not splits. The two 12x96 doors in the lower area also aimed at `ende` stay teleports. Not published.

conditional_teleports.note: the map's anti-standing trap: a trigger_multiple on top of each block sets the player's name to `default` 0.1 s after landing, and the 1-unit teleport under it is behind filter_activator, so it only fires on a player who stood too long. Imported as per-player sinking blocks (bsp_mechanics.trap_blocks)
